title: In JetBrains Datalore before 2026.4 private notebook files could be downloaded without authentication via published…
description: JetBrains Datalore versions before 2026.4 contain a vulnerability where private notebook files could be downloaded without authentication through published interactive reports. This allows unauthorized users to access sensitive notebook content. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 5.9, indicating a medium severity impact primarily affecting confidentiality.
